SPFA Bellman-Ford SPFA (Shortest Path Faster Algorithm) SPFA Bellman-Ford O ( nm ) Code void SPFA( int s) { vector< int > dis(n + 1, INF); queue< int > q; vector< int > vis(n + 1); // vis[u]: u dis[s] = 0; q.push(s), vis[s] = 1; while (!q.empty()) { int u = q.front(); q.pop(), vis[u] = 0; if (dis[u] >= INF) continue ; for ( auto [v, w]: G[u]) { if (dis[v] <= dis[u] + w) continue ; dis[v] = dis[u] + w; if (!vis[v]) q.push(v), vis[v] = 1; // v } } } Bellman-Ford 2026 7 23 13 / 43
